notes.title: Collinwood is Now Available in Early Access!
notes.content:
Hi There,

We’re excited to announce that Collinwood is now available in Early Access! This is just the beginning—immerse yourself in a vibrant and peaceful sandbox, teeming with wildlife and nature. Gather resources, build your ideal homestead, and carve out your place in the wild—or simply relax and enjoy the wilderness. No management, no goals—just pure tranquility.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45249584/318fd20aede66317f20d9b0214ef8e736e7e7654.jpg[/img]

As this is an Early Access release, some content may be missing or still in development. That’s why we’re bringing it to you now—to involve you in shaping Collinwood’s future! Expect more features, improvements, and updates as we continue building the game together.

Your feedback is essential in making Collinwood even better! Join us now and be part of the creative process.

Egret
Lead Developer

notes.title: Happy New Year, Collinwood Community! 🎮 ✨
notes.content:
Happy New Year, Collinwood Community! 🎮 ✨

I wanted to start 2025 by sharing some exciting updates about the development of Collinwood. After months of dedicated development and refinement, I'm thrilled to announce that we're targeting a late March 2025 release for Early Access! 🎯

The development journey has been intense but rewarding, and I've been working hard to ensure that Collinwood delivers an experience worth waiting for. I am currently putting the finishing touches on a trailer that I'll be sharing with you soon, giving you a proper look at what I've been crafting behind the scenes. 🎬

If you haven't wishlisted Collinwood yet, consider adding it to stay updated as I share more information in the coming weeks! 📋

Thank you for being part of this journey. I'm looking forward to sharing more news soon and, most importantly, getting Collinwood into your hands this March!

See you in the next update! ✨

Egret,
Lead Developer.
